title: Daily Life Paragraph
titleMy: နေ့စဉ်ဘဝအကြောင်း စာပိုဒ်
description: A short paragraph about a normal day; type it smoothly until the words stop needing your attention.

exercises.instruction: Type the paragraph at a steady pace; keep your eyes ahead of your hands.
exercises.text: I wake up at six in the morning and brush my teeth. Then I eat breakfast and take the bus to work. I return home in the evening and watch a little television.
